Messages.Author: Gray
Messages.Body:
Ok...here's something we've tried figuring out here...

Let's take Army of Rats. To burn that card, you have to take a
"directed" action. If one is played by my predator, does that
mean that I can attempt to burn it whenever I want to (WITHOUT the
use of any additional cards)? Or do I have to use a card that gives
me a directed action (such as Bum's Rush) to attempt to burn it?

What's that call?

Thanks!

Mike

Messages.Author: Stephen Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
In article <3lujs1$k...@pulsar.sky.net>, glit...@solar.sky.net (Gray) wrote:
 If one is played by my predator, does that
> mean that I can attempt to burn it whenever I want to (WITHOUT the
> use of any additional cards)? Or do I have to use a card that gives
> me a directed action (such as Bum's Rush) to attempt to burn it?

The AoR card itself gives you the directed action. All you need is a
minion who takes the action. No other card is necessary.

Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <3lujs1$k...@pulsar.sky.net>, Gray <glit...@solar.sky.net> wrote:
>Ok...here's something we've tried figuring out here...
>
>Let's take Army of Rats. To burn that card, you have to take a

>"directed" action. If one is played by my predator, does that

Any card that allows you to take an action ((D), political,
whatever) to affect it grants you the right to do so without using
another card. It is that card itself which makes the ability possible.
So to burn AoR, you just tap a minion and declare that you're burning
the AoR. Other examples are Haven Uncovered, Elysium, Madness Network,
The Rack, the powerbases and Archon.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Gray <glit...@solar.sky.net> wrote:
>Let's take Army of Rats. To burn that card, you have to take a
>"directed" action. If one is played by my predator, does that

>mean that I can attempt to burn it whenever I want to (WITHOUT the
>use of any additional cards)? Or do I have to use a card that gives
>me a directed action (such as Bum's Rush) to attempt to burn it?

Well, you can only try to burn it during your minion phase :) but no,
you don't need to dig up an action card in order to burn it. The Army of
Rats itself is what's providing the action.
